summary.text: Decaying Wooden Death is an immortal killer move Wooden Statue Lord Wu Guang names when a grey light pillar pierces a ginseng trunk.

claims.text: In Northern Plains, rank seven wood path Gu Immortal Wu Guang, titled Wooden Statue Lord, finds a gigantic yellowish ginseng whose roots protrude across a hundred li. He wants to kill it for immortal materials before Huang Jin bloodline tribes notice him. He first unleashes a killer move. Greenish grey wooden spikes the size of ancient trees stab into the ginseng roots and pin them to the ground. The surrounding roots fall in number.

After those roots thin to a certain extent, Wu Guang names the immortal killer move and pushes with both palms. A loud explosion sounds. A grey light pillar shoots through the sky and lands on the ginseng trunk. A huge hole forms. The light pillar pierces the trunk at once. The roots still attacking him lose their strength and fall like feeble insects.

Wu Guang smiles and takes the fight as finished. The ground then shakes. A thousand ginseng roots appear at once, each over a hundred feet high. He realizes the trunk he hit was only a larger branch of the plant, close to rank eight at the peak of an ancient desolate plant.
